This product is supplied without battery and charger. DeWalt 5.0ah batteries now on offer! Please see product code 6328D.

Compact and well balanced planer with a 2mm depth of cut and a 9mm rebate capacity. 0.1mm indexed fine adjustment for accurate planing. Brushless motor for excellent efficiency and long tool life. XR switch and module protect the motor from overload and battery from deep discharge. AirLock port compatibility with dust bag or extraction. Traditional blade change with hex wrench or TX key. Includes on-board blade storage for 2 x 82mm blades and TX key storage to minimise down time. Supplied with 82mm reversible TCT blades, guide fence and alignment guide. Compatible with DEWALT XR Li-ion slide pack batteries.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
